cya-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，莱凯安托万-西蒙国际机场（CYA）的跑道嵌在城镇、农田与植被之间。
cya-sat-1.webp.en: On the satellite image, the runway at Antoine-Simon International Airport (CYA) sits between town, farmland and vegetation.

cya-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 绿色廊棚下挂着“欢迎来到安托万·西蒙莱凯国际机场”的白色法文标牌，下方人群正在入内。
cya-chatgpt-01.webp.en: A white sign under a pale green canopy welcomes visitors in French to Antoine Simon International Airport at Les Cayes, with people passing below it.

cya-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 阴云下，一架白色支线客机在深色停机坪上滑行，尾吊双发与绿树背景清晰可见。
cya-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Under an overcast sky, a white regional jet with rear-mounted engines and a T-tail taxis across the dark asphalt apron past a wall of green trees.

cya-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 正午阳光下，一架绿白相间的单发涡桨小飞机停在水泥停机坪上，舱门敞开，有人站在门边。
cya-chatgpt-03.webp.en: In bright midday sun, a small green and white single-engine turboprop stands on the concrete apron with its cabin door open and a person at the step.

cya-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 蓝色涂装的支线喷气机滑过湿漉漉的跑道，两侧水柱喷起水门，两名消防员在草地边操作水枪。
cya-chatgpt-04.webp.en: A blue and white regional jet rolls along the wet runway through a water-cannon salute, while two firefighters in dark gear aim hoses from the grass.

cya-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 铁丝网旁立着蓝底白字的“安托万·西蒙莱凯机场”标牌，棕榈与粉色夹竹桃花在晴空下伸展。
cya-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A blue sign lettered Aeroport Antoine Simon des Cayes stands beside a chain-link fence, with a palm and pink oleander blossoms under a bright sky dotted with cumulus clouds.

cya-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 落日把停机坪染成金色，白色小航站楼外墙上写着“LES CAYES”，几名旅客站在楼前。
cya-chatgpt-06.webp.en: The setting sun turns the apron gold behind a small white terminal whose wall reads Les Cayes Airport, as a few travellers stand near the entrance.

cya-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 浅绿色的到达厅入口挂着写有“ARRIVÉE”并带两个向下箭头的白牌，蓝色栏杆外是灌木与棕榈叶。
cya-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A pale mint-green arrivals entrance carries a white sign reading Arrivee above two downward arrows, with blue railings and shrubs in front.
